view2: แบบโครงสร้างหลังคา 1:75 + หมายเหตุ legend — 2C-150 roof beams at +4.16 / +4.53, rafters, purlins (roof_frame_plan)
warnings: Ring-beam (คานรับหลังคา) plan at the top of the walls — a beam_plan by the section 1 rule (an อะเส/ring-beam sheet is the beam plan; the roof frame is view2). Every RC member prints its own level: RB1 +3.79 (row A 1-3, grid 1 A-C), RB2 +3.79 (grid 3 A-C), RB2 +3.91 (row B 3-5), RB2 +3.64 (row C 1-3), RB1 +3.64 (grid 5 B-D), RB1' +3.64 (grid 2 C-D, row D 2-5).

Splits only at columns: C1 is tagged on this plan at C1, C3, C5, D2, D4, D5. A1, A3 and B5 are the high column tops with no C1 tag; the steel-plate callout (embedded plate + dowels, recorded as a connection_detail) points at A1 and at B5. Row B 3-5 starts on the grid-3 RB2 at B3 and grid 2 C-D starts on the row-C RB2 at C2 (no column at B3 or C2) — flagged bears_on_beam.

No beam on row C between grids 3 and 5, and none on grid 4 or 4' at this level: the whole of B-C x 3-5 plus C-D x 2-5 is one OPEN bay (dashed cross), and A-C x 1-3 is a second OPEN bay (open = no slab at roof level).

Steel 2C-150x50x20x3.2 overhangs (dash-dot, legend on view2) continue the ring beams to the roof edge: row A left of grid 1 to 1' (1.00, printed on view2/A-03) and right of grid 3 to 3' (scaled, not printed), and row B right of grid 5 to 5' (scaled, not printed). They carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). The two scaled ones are span_source scaled_from_grid with confidence 0.75.
A thin line is drawn inside the A-C x 1-3 bay just next to the grid-3 RB2, slanting from the A end to the C end — not labelled; left uninterpreted (not a member).
The dashed outlines around the plan are the roof edges (two roof parts; see grid master) — not members.
